items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...He played Pete Lallis with King Oliver, Old Man Balto.

ctx.x: Let's see, we're recording today in Seminar Room 2 of the Howard Tilton Memorial Library, Tulane University. What's today's date anyway? Friday the 13th. October the 13th, 1961. Let's get your name down there. Mary Alfred Williams. Elizabeth Snail. Yeah, I'm Dick Allen. And we were talking about that piano player that suddenly came to you. Yeah, Buddy Christian. And where did he play? He played Pete Lallis with King Oliver, Old Man Balto.
Okay, let's see this is real too Alfred Williams, October the 13th 1961. You were telling me about Henry Martin too, he played out at the bungalow?
